name: Defect Analysis (next generation)
summary: Announced September 9, 2026. Adds aircraft fault data and part failures to every chronic, with AI chronic detection, rogue-parts detection that flags components statistically linked to recurring defects, AI chronic summaries and a conversational Fix Agent. Every AI suggestion goes through operator review.
paragraphs: Announced September 9, 2026. Adds aircraft fault data and part failures to every chronic, with AI chronic detection, rogue-parts detection that flags components statistically linked to recurring defects, AI chronic summaries and a conversational Fix Agent. whyItMatters: Repeat defects drive delays and wasted parts and labor. The rogue-parts view is the one to test: if it points at the part behind a chronic before the next removal, it pays for itself.
